#################### BLGW797 dataset  Description ##############################################
#         BLGW797 is a dataset of 797 Non-redundant PDB chain of Buldge type W.                #
#         PDB resolution is maximum 2 Angstrom and PDB chain length is minimum 80 amino acid.  #
#         This dataset is generated by PROMOTIF.                                               #
#         There are three line in each PDB, First line is PDB ID with chain,                   #
#         Second is amino acid sequence in single letter code,                                 #
#         and third line is assignment of Buldge Type W at each amino acid residue             #
#         corresponding to amino acid of respective PDB sequence, where plus (+) sign indicate #
#         the corresponding amino acid occur in Buldge Type W  while sign(-) indicates amino   #
#         acid residues not occur in Buldge Type W.                                            #
#################### Dataset Description end    ################################################
